skill_level.name: 脉冲波
skill_level.description: 向四周喷发脉冲波，对周围所有我方与敌方单位造成<@ba.vup>{value}</>真实伤害。并使特殊敌人获得强化。

inputs.enemy_attribute_origin: EnemyDB+level reference; explicit empty global modifiers
inputs.scope: declarations and pre-global enemy HP; range boxes are not Physics2D hit decisions

external_inputs.physics: three explicit overlap snapshots; no collision engine
external_inputs.prepared_time: explicit prepared field fixture: preDelay=.6,duration=0,cooldown=0; native preparation not executed
external_inputs.scheduler_complete: one-actor fixture true; original wave scheduler not connected
